```artifact
Feature: Virtual Healthcare Services within Padmavathi Hospital Zone

  Scenario: Patient within 25 sqkm radius can register for appointments
    Given the patient resides within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the patient to register successfully

  Scenario: Patient outside 25 sqkm radius cannot register for appointments
    Given the patient resides outside a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should deny the registration and display an error message "Registration not allowed outside the specified zone"

  Scenario Outline: Patient within specified PinCodes can register for appointments
    Given the patient resides in PinCode <PinCode>
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the patient to register successfully

    Examples:
      | PinCode |
      | 517501  |
      | 517502  |
      | 517503  |

  Scenario Outline: Patient outside specified PinCodes cannot register for appointments
    Given the patient resides in PinCode <PinCode>
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should deny the registration and display an error message "Registration not allowed outside the specified zone"

    Examples:
      | PinCode |
      | 517001  |
      | 517002  |
      | 517003  |

  Scenario: There is 1 Authorized Chemist per PinCode
    Given the patient resides in PinCode 517501
    When the system checks for authorized chemists in the patient's PinCode
    Then the system should find exactly 1 authorized chemist

  Scenario: Prescription requests are routed to the correct Chemist based on PinCode
    Given the patient resides in PinCode 517501 and has submitted a prescription request
    When the system routes the prescription request
    Then the prescription request should be routed to the authorized chemist in PinCode 517501

  Scenario: Chemist delivers medicines through Offline delivery and collects payments
    Given the chemist has received a prescription request for PinCode 517501
    When the chemist delivers the medicines to the patient
    Then the chemist should collect payment from the patient

  Scenario: Chemist marks the Prescription as completed after delivery
    Given the chemist has delivered medicines to the patient in PinCode 517501
    When the chemist completes the delivery
    Then the system should mark the prescription as completed

  Scenario: No systemic matching is done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist
    Given the system has processed a prescription request for PinCode 517501
    When the system checks for efficiency metrics of the chemist
    Then the system should not perform any systemic matching to determine the chemist's efficiency

  Scenario: There is 1 Authorized Laboratory per PinCode or 1 Laboratory for the entire Zone
    Given the patient resides in PinCode 517501
    When the system checks for authorized laboratories in the patient's PinCode
    Then the system should find exactly 1 authorized laboratory in PinCode 517501 or in the entire Zone
```
